characters.name: [Furious Fighter's Immense Power] Super Saiyan Goku
aliases: [Furious Fighter's Immense Power] Super Saiyan Goku
characters.skill_orbs:
Focus on raw def & atk, followed by dodge and add with orbs.


You can lean slightly more into dodge because dodge adds consistency in base and will make him age a little better post transformation, but it can interfere with his damage post transformation, which is why I personally lean towards add because of that. I lean towards def with equips (especially at lower dupe levels) because it makes his tanking much more consistent, but atk is also very valuable. Crit is mostly irrelevant because he has attacks effective against all types in both forms and 50% crit post transformation after being hit.

characters.name: [Supreme Ruler's Vicious Power] Frieza (Final Form)
characters.skill_orbs:
Focus on raw DEF, followed by atk, additional, and dodge with orbs.


Almost any mix of dodge and add works (I think 12 add + 9 dodge will be best for him, though). Dodge will make him age slightly better by giving him an extra safety net, while additional will make his damage output better; lean into whichever outcome you prefer. def is going to make his tanking even more consistent(especially at a low dupe level), and atk will help make his already very good damage better. He has attacks effective against all types in base and gains 20% crit within turn every time he’s hit post transformation, so crit isn’t very useful. Gaining crit chance within the turn on being hit can make dodge counter intuitive sometimes, which is the primary reason I lean slightly towards add in the build.
